integrity.finite_checks: Exact-rational exhaustive comparisons on orders four through six, plus a full edge-count rational sweep on orders four through thirty.
integrity.priority_limit: A general earlier induced-subgraph moment formula may contain an implication-equivalent specialization; the search does not establish uniqueness.

scientific_limitations: Exact formulas concern uniform fixed-edge G(n,m) and independent-edge G(n,p), not arbitrary random graph models.
The variables are unordered induced counts on three-vertex sets; the result is a covariance sign, not stochastic negative association.
The asymptotic limit assumes a fixed interior edge-density limit.
Independent historical-priority and scientific validation remain unperformed.
title: A universal negative triangle–open-wedge covariance under fixed-edge conditioning
